description: This file defines the Telemetry class, which is a plugin for JSONRPC communication within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for handling report profiles, application events, report uploads, and aborts, and includes interface implementations and internal state management.

classes.name: Telemetry
classes.description: A plugin class for handling telemetry data and JSONRPC communication within WPEFramework.

methods.name: setReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the report profile status based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: logApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: uploadReport
methods.description: Uploads a report, possibly triggering internal report handling.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: onReportUploadStatus
methods.description: Handles report upload status updates (conditional on HAS_RBUS).

methods.name: notifyT2PrivacyMode
methods.description: Notifies privacy mode status (conditional on HAS_RBUS).
